name: market_brief_market_data_lq939_20261108
comment: ANCHOR: MARKET_BRIEF_MARKET_DATA_LQ939_20261108 — the market-data block of the market-event brief
(LQ-20261107-939 part 4). The Sunday 20:00 ET brief rendered the MarketEvent@v1 payload only; it carried no
futures, cash-index levels, movers, sectors or international exposure. scripts/lib/market_brief_inputs.py reads
four sections with the caller's read-only db_query -- market_quotes_extended (off-hours futures and cash indices;
a carried cash-index level is level-only and labelled with its print), market_movers (newest capture per signal,
gainers DESC, losers ASC, bounded), sector_rs_daily + sector_momentum_state (newest RS date, LEFT JOIN so a
missing state is null, never invented), market_quotes (international ETFs, basis etf_derived) -- and the brief
renders them. OPT-IN via ?market_data=1 (policy market_data true), so the CC's poll of the route stays cheap.
Honesty: a failed read is 'unavailable' with its reason and an empty table is 'empty' with a note; neither is
ever rendered as zeros, and every section states its own as-of. Hermetic: fake db_query, no DB, no network.
